crossRefs.note: The messengers returned to him, and he said to them, “Why is it that you have returned?”

translations.web: The messengers returned to him, and he said to them, “Why is it that you have returned?”
translations.bsb: When the messengers returned to the king, he asked them, “Why have you returned?”
translations.kjv: And when the messengers turned back unto him, he said unto them, Why are ye now turned back?
translations.asv: And the messengers returned unto him, and he said unto them, Why is it that ye are returned?
